<script type="text/javascript">
    if (typeof Object.assign !== 'function') {
        Object.assign = function (target) {
            for (var i = 1; i < arguments.length; i++) {
                var source = arguments[i];
                for (var key in source) {
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source, key)) {
                        target[key] = source[key];
                    }
                }
            }
            return target;
        };
    }

    if (!String.prototype.startsWith) {
        try {
            Object.defineProperty(String.prototype, 'startsWith', {
                value: function (search, rawPos) {
                    var pos = rawPos > 0 ? rawPos | 0 : 0;
                    return this.substring(pos, pos + search.length) === search;
                }
            });
        } catch (e) {
            String.prototype.startsWith = function (search, rawPos) {
                var pos = rawPos > 0 ? rawPos | 0 : 0;
                return this.substring(pos, pos + search.length) === search;
            };
        }
    }

    var ConsentStore = {};
    var ConsentProviderRegistry = {};
    var ConsentGate = {};

    var CookieConsentListener = {};
    var CookieConsentRepository = {};
    var CookieConsentBanner = { closed: false };

    (function()
    {
        function CookieConsent(functional, performance, targeting)
        {
            this.functional = functional;
            this.performance = performance;
            this.targeting = targeting;
        }

        /**
         * @returns {CookieConsent}
         */
        CookieConsent.makeDefaultNoConsent = function()
        {
            var functional = false, performance = false, targeting = false;
            return new CookieConsent(functional, performance, targeting);
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.pagesWhereBannerIsHidden = [
            "/cookies-privacy-policy/",
        ];

        CookieConsentBanner.hide = function () {
            ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().hide();
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.show = function () {
            ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().show();
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.onCookiePreferencesClick = function (callback) {
            if (document.getElementById("ot-sdk-btn") !== null) {
                document.getElementById("ot-sdk-btn").addEventListener("click", callback);
            }
        }

        CookieConsentBanner.whenReady = function () {
            var waitedForMs = 0;
            var intervalDelayInMs = 10;

            function getActiveProviderSafely() {
                try {
                    return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                var interval = setInterval(function () {
                    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
                        return;
                    }
                    waitedForMs += intervalDelayInMs;

                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider || !provider.isReady()) {
                        if (waitedForMs <= 2000) {
                            return;
                        }

                        clearInterval(interval);

                        var reason = !provider
                            ? "no consent provider is registered"
                            : "consent provider is not ready";

                        reject("After " + waitedForMs + "ms, " + reason + ".");

                        return;
                    }

                    clearInterval(interval);
                    resolve();
                }, intervalDelayInMs);
            });
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.onConsentResolved = function () {
            var intervalDelayInMs = 10;
            var timeoutInMs = 2000;

            function getActiveProviderSafely() {
                try {
                    return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        
            return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                var finished = false;
                var interval;
                var timeout;
        
                function cleanup() {
                    if (finished) {
                        return;
                    }
        
                    finished = true;
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    clearTimeout(timeout);
                }
        
                interval = setInterval(function () {
                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (!provider.isDecided()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    cleanup();
                    resolve('resolved');
                }, intervalDelayInMs);
        
                timeout = setTimeout(function () {
                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider) {
                        cleanup();
                        resolve('timeout');
                    }
                }, timeoutInMs);
            });
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        var _state = { functional: false, performance: false, targeting: false };
        var _listeners = [];

        ConsentStore.getState = function () {
            return Object.assign({}, _state);
        };

        ConsentStore.setState = function (partial) {
            var prev = Object.assign({}, _state);
            _state = Object.assign({}, _state, partial);
            var next = Object.assign({}, _state);
            for (var i = 0; i < _listeners.length; i++) {
                _listeners[i](next, prev);
            }
        };

        ConsentStore.subscribe = function (fn) {
            _listeners.push(fn);
            return function unsubscribe() {
                var updated = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < _listeners.length; i++) {
                    if (_listeners[i] !== fn) {
                        updated.push(_listeners[i]);
                    }
                }
                _listeners = updated;
            };
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // Consent provider interface
        // =========================================================================

        var consentProviderInterface = {
            methods: ['getType', 'init', 'show', 'hide', 'isReady', 'isDecided'],
            ensureIsImplementedBy: function (object) {
                for (var i = 0; i < this.methods.length; i++) {
                    var method = this.methods[i];
                    if (!object[method] || typeof object[method] !== 'function') {
                        throw new Error(
                            "Consent provider does not implement the 'consent provider interface' correctly."
                            + " The method '" + method + "' was not found."
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        };


        // =========================================================================
        // Consent Provider Registry
        // =========================================================================

        var _consentProvider = null;

        ConsentProviderRegistry.register = function (provider) {
            consentProviderInterface.ensureIsImplementedBy(provider);
            _consentProvider = provider;
        };

        ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive = function () {
            if (!_consentProvider) {
                throw new Error('No consent provider has been registered.');
            }
            return _consentProvider;
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // CookieConsentRepository — facade over ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        CookieConsentRepository.fetch = function () {
            return ConsentStore.getState();
        };

        CookieConsentRepository.hasUserDecided = function () {
            return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().isDecided();
        };


        // =========================================================================
        // CookieConsentListener — facade over ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        CookieConsentListener.onFunctionalConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.functional !== prev.functional) {
                    callback(next.functional);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.onPerformanceConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.performance !== prev.performance) {
                    callback(next.performance);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.onTargetingConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.targeting !== prev.targeting) {
                    callback(next.targeting);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.triggerChange = function (partialConsent) {
            ConsentStore.setState(partialConsent || {});
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentGate
        // =========================================================================

        var consentGateInterface = {
            options: ['requires', 'selector', 'on', 'off'],
            validCategories: ['functional', 'performance', 'targeting'],
        
            ensureIsValidFor: function (options) {
                for (var i = 0; i < this.options.length; i++) {
                    var option = this.options[i];
                    if (!options[option]) {
                        throw new Error(
                            "ConsentGate registration is missing required option '" + option + "'."
                        );
                    }
                }
        
                if (typeof options.on !== 'function') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'on' must be a function.");
                }
        
                if (typeof options.off !== 'function') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'off' must be a function.");
                }
        
                if (typeof options.selector !== 'string') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'selector' must be a string.");
                }
        
                if (this.validCategories.indexOf(options.requires) === -1) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "ConsentGate 'requires' must be one of: " + this.validCategories.join(', ') + "."
                        + " Got: '" + options.requires + "'."
                    );
                }
            }
        };        

        var _gates = [];

        ConsentGate.register = function (options) {
            consentGateInterface.ensureIsValidFor(options);
            _gates.push(options);
        };

        ConsentGate.init = function (store) {
            var state = store.getState();
            for (var i = 0; i < _gates.length; i++) {
                _applyGate(_gates[i], state[_gates[i].requires]);
            }

            store.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                for (var i = 0; i < _gates.length; i++) {
                    var category = _gates[i].requires;
                    if (next[category] !== prev[category]) {
                        _applyGate(_gates[i], next[category]);
                    }
                }
            });
        };

        function _applyGate(gate, hasConsent) {
            var elements = document.querySelectorAll(gate.selector);
            for (var i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) {
                if (hasConsent) {
                    gate.on(elements[i]);
                } else {
                    gate.off(elements[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentGate registrations
        // =========================================================================

        ConsentGate.register({
            requires: 'targeting',
            selector: '.youtube-player',
            on: function (el) {
                var src = el.getAttribute('data-src');
                if (src) {
                    el.setAttribute('src', src);
                }
            },
            off: function (el) {
                el.setAttribute('src', '');
            },
        });

        ConsentGate.register({
            requires: 'functional',
            selector: '.vimeo-player',
            on: function (el) {
                var src = el.getAttribute('data-src');
                if (src) {
                    el.setAttribute('src', src);
                }
            },
            off: function (el) {
                el.setAttribute('src', '');
            },
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Boot
        // =========================================================================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            var provider = ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
            provider.init(ConsentStore);
            ConsentGate.init(ConsentStore);
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Show Cookie content Banner
        // =========================================================================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            CookieConsentBanner.onCookiePreferencesClick(function () {
                try {
                    CookieConsentBanner.show();
                } catch (e) {
                    // We don't have an active provider. Ignore
                }
            });
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Hide Cookie content Banner
        // =========================================================================
        CookieConsentBanner.whenReady()
            .then(function () {
                if (CookieConsentBanner.pagesWhereBannerIsHidden.indexOf(window.location.pathname) !== -1) {
                    try {
                        CookieConsentBanner.hide();
                    } catch (e) {
                        // We don't have an active provider. Ignore
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(function (e) {
                Bugsnag.leaveBreadcrumb("[CookieConsentBanner] Unhandled exception while executing whenReady", {
                    exception: e
                });                
            });
    }());
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">
    var GoogleTCFProvider = (function() {

        var _decided = false;

        return {
            getType: function() {
                return 'google-tcf';
            },
            init: function(store) {
                var interval = setInterval(function() {
                    if (typeof window.__tcfapi !== 'function') {
                        return;
                    }

                    clearInterval(interval);

                    window.__tcfapi('addEventListener', 2, function(tcData, success) {
                        if (!success) {
                            return;
                        }

                        if (tcData.eventStatus !== 'useractioncomplete' &&
                            tcData.eventStatus !== 'tcloaded') {
                            return;
                        }

                        _decided = true;

                        store.setState({
                            functional: tcData.purpose.consents[1] === true,
                            performance: (
                                tcData.purpose.consents[7] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[8] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[9] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[10] === true
                            ),
                            targeting: (
                                tcData.purpose.consents[3] === true ||
                                tcData.purpose.consents[4] === true
                            ),
                        });
                    });
                }, 50);
            },

            show: function() {
                if (window.googlefc) { 
                    window.googlefc.showRevocationMessage(); 
                }
            },

            hide: function() {
                // TCF does not expose a programmatic hide
            },

            isReady: function() {
                return typeof window.__tcfapi === 'function';
            },

            isDecided: function() {
                return _decided;
            },
        };

    }());

    ConsentProviderRegistry.register(GoogleTCFProvider);
</script>

    if (typeof gtag === "undefined") {
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
        gtag = function(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
    }
    gtag('set', { 'send_page_view': false });

    var cookieConsent = CookieConsentRepository.fetch();

    gtag('consent', 'default', {
        'ad_storage': cookieConsent.targeting ? "granted" : "denied",
        'ad_user_data': cookieConsent.targeting ? "granted" : "denied",
        'ad_personalization': cookieConsent.targeting ? "granted" : "denied",

    });

    var DisplayAds = {
        display: function (identifier) {
            if (!window.location.hostname.includes("thejournal.ie")) {
                this.debugLog("Subscription check skipped, not on The Journal");
                this.deferredDisplay(false, identifier);
                return;
            }

            if (!userRepository.hasUser()) {
                this.debugLog("Subscription check skipped, user not signed in");
                this.deferredDisplay(false, identifier);
                return;
            }

            if (subscriptionCheck.isAvailable()) {
                this.debugLog("Subscription check immediately available");
                this.deferredDisplay(subscriptionCheck.isActive(), identifier);
                return;
            }

            var timeoutId = window.setTimeout(
                function () {
                    DisplayAds.debugLog("Subscription check timed out");
                    DisplayAds.deferredDisplay(false, identifier);
                },
                1000
            );

            subscriptionCheck.registerListener(function (isActive) {
                DisplayAds.debugLog("Subscription check listener executed");
                DisplayAds.deferredDisplay(isActive, identifier);
                window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            });
        },

<script>
    // Cache DOM elements
    const mainNavToggleHandler = document.getElementById('main-nav-toggle-handler');
    const navigationMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-categories-redesign');
    const navigationOpenButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-open');
    const navigationCloseButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-close');
    const navigationLogo = document.querySelector('.main-navigation-logo');
    const navigationModalContainer = document.querySelector('.navigation-modal-container');
    const navigationOverlay = document.querySelector('.navigation-overlay');

    navigationOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mainNavToggleHandler.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('click'));
    });

    // Event handler for main navigation toggle
    mainNavToggleHandler.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const positionY = Math.abs(parseInt(document.body.style.top));
        const leaderBoardContainerHeight = document.getElementById('header_leaderboard_container').clientHeight;

        document.body.classList.toggle('scroll-hidden');
        navigationMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationOpenButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationCloseButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationLogo.classList.toggle('hidden');

        // Handle scroll position when navigation is open and leaderboard is visible
        if (document.body.classList.contains('scroll-hidden')) {
            document.body.style.top = `-${window.scrollY}px`;
            document.body.style.position = 'fixed';
        } else {
            document.body.style.top = '';
            document.body.style.position = '';
            window.scroll(0, positionY);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            const isNavigationOpen = navigationOpenButton.classList.contains('hidden');
            const isModalVisible = elementIsVisibleInViewport(navigationModalContainer);

            if (isNavigationOpen && !isModalVisible) {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = `calc(100vh - ${leaderBoardContainerHeight}px - 68px)`;
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'scroll';
            } else {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = 'auto';
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'auto';
            }
        }, 1000);
    });

    // Helper function to check if an element is visible in the viewport
    const elementIsVisibleInViewport = (el, partiallyVisible = false) => {
        const { top, left, bottom, right } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const { innerHeight, innerWidth } = window;
        return partiallyVisible
            ? ((top > 0 && top < innerHeight) || (bottom > 0 && bottom < innerHeight)) &&
            ((left > 0 && left < innerWidth) || (right > 0 && right < innerWidth))
            : top >= 0 && left >= 0 && bottom <= innerHeight && right <= innerWidth;
    };
</script>

<script>
    // Cache DOM elements
    const mainNavToggleHandler = document.getElementById('main-nav-toggle-handler');
    const navigationMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-categories-redesign');
    const navigationOpenButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-open');
    const navigationCloseButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-close');
    const navigationLogo = document.querySelector('.main-navigation-logo');
    const navigationModalContainer = document.querySelector('.navigation-modal-container');
    const navigationOverlay = document.querySelector('.navigation-overlay');

    navigationOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mainNavToggleHandler.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('click'));
    });

    // Event handler for main navigation toggle
    mainNavToggleHandler.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const positionY = Math.abs(parseInt(document.body.style.top));
        const leaderBoardContainerHeight = document.getElementById('header_leaderboard_container').clientHeight;

        document.body.classList.toggle('scroll-hidden');
        navigationMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationOpenButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationCloseButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationLogo.classList.toggle('hidden');

        // Handle scroll position when navigation is open and leaderboard is visible
        if (document.body.classList.contains('scroll-hidden')) {
            document.body.style.top = `-${window.scrollY}px`;
            document.body.style.position = 'fixed';
        } else {
            document.body.style.top = '';
            document.body.style.position = '';
            window.scroll(0, positionY);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            const isNavigationOpen = navigationOpenButton.classList.contains('hidden');
            const isModalVisible = elementIsVisibleInViewport(navigationModalContainer);

            if (isNavigationOpen && !isModalVisible) {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = `calc(100vh - ${leaderBoardContainerHeight}px - 68px)`;
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'scroll';
            } else {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = 'auto';
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'auto';
            }
        }, 1000);
    });

    // Helper function to check if an element is visible in the viewport
    const elementIsVisibleInViewport = (el, partiallyVisible = false) => {
        const { top, left, bottom, right } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const { innerHeight, innerWidth } = window;
        return partiallyVisible
            ? ((top > 0 && top < innerHeight) || (bottom > 0 && bottom < innerHeight)) &&
            ((left > 0 && left < innerWidth) || (right > 0 && right < innerWidth))
            : top >= 0 && left >= 0 && bottom <= innerHeight && right <= innerWidth;
    };
</script>

    // Cache DOM elements
    const mainNavToggleHandler = document.getElementById('main-nav-toggle-handler');
    const navigationMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-categories-redesign');
    const navigationOpenButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-open');
    const navigationCloseButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-close');
    const navigationLogo = document.querySelector('.main-navigation-logo');
    const navigationModalContainer = document.querySelector('.navigation-modal-container');
    const navigationOverlay = document.querySelector('.navigation-overlay');

    navigationOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mainNavToggleHandler.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('click'));
    });

    // Event handler for main navigation toggle
    mainNavToggleHandler.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const positionY = Math.abs(parseInt(document.body.style.top));
        const leaderBoardContainerHeight = document.getElementById('header_leaderboard_container').clientHeight;

        document.body.classList.toggle('scroll-hidden');
        navigationMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationOpenButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationCloseButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationLogo.classList.toggle('hidden');

        // Handle scroll position when navigation is open and leaderboard is visible
        if (document.body.classList.contains('scroll-hidden')) {
            document.body.style.top = `-${window.scrollY}px`;
            document.body.style.position = 'fixed';
        } else {
            document.body.style.top = '';
            document.body.style.position = '';
            window.scroll(0, positionY);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            const isNavigationOpen = navigationOpenButton.classList.contains('hidden');
            const isModalVisible = elementIsVisibleInViewport(navigationModalContainer);

            if (isNavigationOpen && !isModalVisible) {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = `calc(100vh - ${leaderBoardContainerHeight}px - 68px)`;
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'scroll';
            } else {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = 'auto';
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'auto';
            }
        }, 1000);
    });

    // Helper function to check if an element is visible in the viewport
    const elementIsVisibleInViewport = (el, partiallyVisible = false) => {
        const { top, left, bottom, right } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const { innerHeight, innerWidth } = window;
        return partiallyVisible
            ? ((top > 0 && top < innerHeight) || (bottom > 0 && bottom < innerHeight)) &&
            ((left > 0 && left < innerWidth) || (right > 0 && right < innerWidth))
            : top >= 0 && left >= 0 && bottom <= innerHeight && right <= innerWidth;
    };

<script type="text/javascript">
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        loadVotedPolls();

        var form = document.getElementById('daily-poll-redesign-form');

        if (form) {
            var pollId = form.elements['poll'].value;

            form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();

                loadVotedPolls();

                if (hasVotedPoll(pollId)) {
                    alert("You've already voted!");
                    location.reload();
                    return;
                }

                votedPollAction(pollId);

                form.submit();
            });

            if (hasVotedPoll(pollId)) {
                form.style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('daily-poll-redesign-results').style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
    });

    let pollsHistory = 200;
    let pollArray = [];

    let loadVotedPolls = function () {
        let pollList = localStorage.getItem('polls');
        if (pollList != null) {
            pollArray = JSON.parse(pollList);
        }
    };

    let hasVotedPoll = function (pollId) {
        return pollArray.indexOf("poll_" + pollId) != -1;
    };

    let votedPollAction = function (pollId) {
        while (pollArray.length >= pollsHistory) {
            pollArray.shift();
        }
        pollArray.push("poll_" + pollId);
        localStorage.setItem('polls', JSON.stringify(pollArray));
    };

    //Array indexof on prototype, ie issues
    if (!Array.indexOf) {
        Array.prototype.indexOf = function (obj) {
            for (let i = 0; i < this.length; i++) {
                if (this[i] == obj) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
            return -1;
        }
    }
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    if (typeof Object.assign !== 'function') {
        Object.assign = function (target) {
            for (var i = 1; i < arguments.length; i++) {
                var source = arguments[i];
                for (var key in source) {
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source, key)) {
                        target[key] = source[key];
                    }
                }
            }
            return target;
        };
    }

    if (!String.prototype.startsWith) {
        try {
            Object.defineProperty(String.prototype, 'startsWith', {
                value: function (search, rawPos) {
                    var pos = rawPos > 0 ? rawPos | 0 : 0;
                    return this.substring(pos, pos + search.length) === search;
                }
            });
        } catch (e) {
            String.prototype.startsWith = function (search, rawPos) {
                var pos = rawPos > 0 ? rawPos | 0 : 0;
                return this.substring(pos, pos + search.length) === search;
            };
        }
    }

    var ConsentStore = {};
    var ConsentProviderRegistry = {};
    var ConsentGate = {};

    var CookieConsentListener = {};
    var CookieConsentRepository = {};
    var CookieConsentBanner = { closed: false };

    (function()
    {
        function CookieConsent(functional, performance, targeting)
        {
            this.functional = functional;
            this.performance = performance;
            this.targeting = targeting;
        }

        /**
         * @returns {CookieConsent}
         */
        CookieConsent.makeDefaultNoConsent = function()
        {
            var functional = false, performance = false, targeting = false;
            return new CookieConsent(functional, performance, targeting);
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.pagesWhereBannerIsHidden = [
            "/cookies-privacy-policy/",
        ];

        CookieConsentBanner.hide = function () {
            ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().hide();
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.show = function () {
            ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().show();
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.onCookiePreferencesClick = function (callback) {
            if (document.getElementById("ot-sdk-btn") !== null) {
                document.getElementById("ot-sdk-btn").addEventListener("click", callback);
            }
        }

        CookieConsentBanner.whenReady = function () {
            var waitedForMs = 0;
            var intervalDelayInMs = 10;

            function getActiveProviderSafely() {
                try {
                    return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                var interval = setInterval(function () {
                    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
                        return;
                    }
                    waitedForMs += intervalDelayInMs;

                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider || !provider.isReady()) {
                        if (waitedForMs <= 2000) {
                            return;
                        }

                        clearInterval(interval);

                        var reason = !provider
                            ? "no consent provider is registered"
                            : "consent provider is not ready";

                        reject("After " + waitedForMs + "ms, " + reason + ".");

                        return;
                    }

                    clearInterval(interval);
                    resolve();
                }, intervalDelayInMs);
            });
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.onConsentResolved = function () {
            var intervalDelayInMs = 10;
            var timeoutInMs = 2000;

            function getActiveProviderSafely() {
                try {
                    return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        
            return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                var finished = false;
                var interval;
                var timeout;
        
                function cleanup() {
                    if (finished) {
                        return;
                    }
        
                    finished = true;
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    clearTimeout(timeout);
                }
        
                interval = setInterval(function () {
                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (!provider.isDecided()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    cleanup();
                    resolve('resolved');
                }, intervalDelayInMs);
        
                timeout = setTimeout(function () {
                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider) {
                        cleanup();
                        resolve('timeout');
                    }
                }, timeoutInMs);
            });
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        var _state = { functional: false, performance: false, targeting: false };
        var _listeners = [];

        ConsentStore.getState = function () {
            return Object.assign({}, _state);
        };

        ConsentStore.setState = function (partial) {
            var prev = Object.assign({}, _state);
            _state = Object.assign({}, _state, partial);
            var next = Object.assign({}, _state);
            for (var i = 0; i < _listeners.length; i++) {
                _listeners[i](next, prev);
            }
        };

        ConsentStore.subscribe = function (fn) {
            _listeners.push(fn);
            return function unsubscribe() {
                var updated = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < _listeners.length; i++) {
                    if (_listeners[i] !== fn) {
                        updated.push(_listeners[i]);
                    }
                }
                _listeners = updated;
            };
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // Consent provider interface
        // =========================================================================

        var consentProviderInterface = {
            methods: ['getType', 'init', 'show', 'hide', 'isReady', 'isDecided'],
            ensureIsImplementedBy: function (object) {
                for (var i = 0; i < this.methods.length; i++) {
                    var method = this.methods[i];
                    if (!object[method] || typeof object[method] !== 'function') {
                        throw new Error(
                            "Consent provider does not implement the 'consent provider interface' correctly."
                            + " The method '" + method + "' was not found."
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        };


        // =========================================================================
        // Consent Provider Registry
        // =========================================================================

        var _consentProvider = null;

        ConsentProviderRegistry.register = function (provider) {
            consentProviderInterface.ensureIsImplementedBy(provider);
            _consentProvider = provider;
        };

        ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive = function () {
            if (!_consentProvider) {
                throw new Error('No consent provider has been registered.');
            }
            return _consentProvider;
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // CookieConsentRepository — facade over ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        CookieConsentRepository.fetch = function () {
            return ConsentStore.getState();
        };

        CookieConsentRepository.hasUserDecided = function () {
            return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().isDecided();
        };


        // =========================================================================
        // CookieConsentListener — facade over ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        CookieConsentListener.onFunctionalConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.functional !== prev.functional) {
                    callback(next.functional);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.onPerformanceConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.performance !== prev.performance) {
                    callback(next.performance);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.onTargetingConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.targeting !== prev.targeting) {
                    callback(next.targeting);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.triggerChange = function (partialConsent) {
            ConsentStore.setState(partialConsent || {});
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentGate
        // =========================================================================

        var consentGateInterface = {
            options: ['requires', 'selector', 'on', 'off'],
            validCategories: ['functional', 'performance', 'targeting'],
        
            ensureIsValidFor: function (options) {
                for (var i = 0; i < this.options.length; i++) {
                    var option = this.options[i];
                    if (!options[option]) {
                        throw new Error(
                            "ConsentGate registration is missing required option '" + option + "'."
                        );
                    }
                }
        
                if (typeof options.on !== 'function') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'on' must be a function.");
                }
        
                if (typeof options.off !== 'function') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'off' must be a function.");
                }
        
                if (typeof options.selector !== 'string') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'selector' must be a string.");
                }
        
                if (this.validCategories.indexOf(options.requires) === -1) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "ConsentGate 'requires' must be one of: " + this.validCategories.join(', ') + "."
                        + " Got: '" + options.requires + "'."
                    );
                }
            }
        };        

        var _gates = [];

        ConsentGate.register = function (options) {
            consentGateInterface.ensureIsValidFor(options);
            _gates.push(options);
        };

        ConsentGate.init = function (store) {
            var state = store.getState();
            for (var i = 0; i < _gates.length; i++) {
                _applyGate(_gates[i], state[_gates[i].requires]);
            }

            store.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                for (var i = 0; i < _gates.length; i++) {
                    var category = _gates[i].requires;
                    if (next[category] !== prev[category]) {
                        _applyGate(_gates[i], next[category]);
                    }
                }
            });
        };

        function _applyGate(gate, hasConsent) {
            var elements = document.querySelectorAll(gate.selector);
            for (var i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) {
                if (hasConsent) {
                    gate.on(elements[i]);
                } else {
                    gate.off(elements[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentGate registrations
        // =========================================================================

        ConsentGate.register({
            requires: 'targeting',
            selector: '.youtube-player',
            on: function (el) {
                var src = el.getAttribute('data-src');
                if (src) {
                    el.setAttribute('src', src);
                }
            },
            off: function (el) {
                el.setAttribute('src', '');
            },
        });

        ConsentGate.register({
            requires: 'functional',
            selector: '.vimeo-player',
            on: function (el) {
                var src = el.getAttribute('data-src');
                if (src) {
                    el.setAttribute('src', src);
                }
            },
            off: function (el) {
                el.setAttribute('src', '');
            },
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Boot
        // =========================================================================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            var provider = ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
            provider.init(ConsentStore);
            ConsentGate.init(ConsentStore);
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Show Cookie content Banner
        // =========================================================================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            CookieConsentBanner.onCookiePreferencesClick(function () {
                try {
                    CookieConsentBanner.show();
                } catch (e) {
                    // We don't have an active provider. Ignore
                }
            });
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Hide Cookie content Banner
        // =========================================================================
        CookieConsentBanner.whenReady()
            .then(function () {
                if (CookieConsentBanner.pagesWhereBannerIsHidden.indexOf(window.location.pathname) !== -1) {
                    try {
                        CookieConsentBanner.hide();
                    } catch (e) {
                        // We don't have an active provider. Ignore
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(function (e) {
                Bugsnag.leaveBreadcrumb("[CookieConsentBanner] Unhandled exception while executing whenReady", {
                    exception: e
                });                
            });
    }());
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">
    var GoogleTCFProvider = (function() {

        var _decided = false;

        return {
            getType: function() {
                return 'google-tcf';
            },
            init: function(store) {
                var interval = setInterval(function() {
                    if (typeof window.__tcfapi !== 'function') {
                        return;
                    }

                    clearInterval(interval);

                    window.__tcfapi('addEventListener', 2, function(tcData, success) {
                        if (!success) {
                            return;
                        }

                        if (tcData.eventStatus !== 'useractioncomplete' &&
                            tcData.eventStatus !== 'tcloaded') {
                            return;
                        }

                        _decided = true;

                        store.setState({
                            functional: tcData.purpose.consents[1] === true,
                            performance: (
                                tcData.purpose.consents[7] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[8] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[9] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[10] === true
                            ),
                            targeting: (
                                tcData.purpose.consents[3] === true ||
                                tcData.purpose.consents[4] === true
                            ),
                        });
                    });
                }, 50);
            },

            show: function() {
                if (window.googlefc) { 
                    window.googlefc.showRevocationMessage(); 
                }
            },

            hide: function() {
                // TCF does not expose a programmatic hide
            },

            isReady: function() {
                return typeof window.__tcfapi === 'function';
            },

            isDecided: function() {
                return _decided;
            },
        };

    }());

    ConsentProviderRegistry.register(GoogleTCFProvider);
</script>

<script>
    // Cache DOM elements
    const mainNavToggleHandler = document.getElementById('main-nav-toggle-handler');
    const navigationMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-categories-redesign');
    const navigationOpenButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-open');
    const navigationCloseButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-close');
    const navigationLogo = document.querySelector('.main-navigation-logo');
    const navigationModalContainer = document.querySelector('.navigation-modal-container');
    const navigationOverlay = document.querySelector('.navigation-overlay');

    navigationOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mainNavToggleHandler.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('click'));
    });

    // Event handler for main navigation toggle
    mainNavToggleHandler.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const positionY = Math.abs(parseInt(document.body.style.top));
        const leaderBoardContainerHeight = document.getElementById('header_leaderboard_container').clientHeight;

        document.body.classList.toggle('scroll-hidden');
        navigationMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationOpenButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationCloseButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationLogo.classList.toggle('hidden');

        // Handle scroll position when navigation is open and leaderboard is visible
        if (document.body.classList.contains('scroll-hidden')) {
            document.body.style.top = `-${window.scrollY}px`;
            document.body.style.position = 'fixed';
        } else {
            document.body.style.top = '';
            document.body.style.position = '';
            window.scroll(0, positionY);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            const isNavigationOpen = navigationOpenButton.classList.contains('hidden');
            const isModalVisible = elementIsVisibleInViewport(navigationModalContainer);

            if (isNavigationOpen && !isModalVisible) {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = `calc(100vh - ${leaderBoardContainerHeight}px - 68px)`;
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'scroll';
            } else {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = 'auto';
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'auto';
            }
        }, 1000);
    });

    // Helper function to check if an element is visible in the viewport
    const elementIsVisibleInViewport = (el, partiallyVisible = false) => {
        const { top, left, bottom, right } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const { innerHeight, innerWidth } = window;
        return partiallyVisible
            ? ((top > 0 && top < innerHeight) || (bottom > 0 && bottom < innerHeight)) &&
            ((left > 0 && left < innerWidth) || (right > 0 && right < innerWidth))
            : top >= 0 && left >= 0 && bottom <= innerHeight && right <= innerWidth;
    };
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    if (typeof Object.assign !== 'function') {
        Object.assign = function (target) {
            for (var i = 1; i < arguments.length; i++) {
                var source = arguments[i];
                for (var key in source) {
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source, key)) {
                        target[key] = source[key];
                    }
                }
            }
            return target;
        };
    }

    if (!String.prototype.startsWith) {
        try {
            Object.defineProperty(String.prototype, 'startsWith', {
                value: function (search, rawPos) {
                    var pos = rawPos > 0 ? rawPos | 0 : 0;
                    return this.substring(pos, pos + search.length) === search;
                }
            });
        } catch (e) {
            String.prototype.startsWith = function (search, rawPos) {
                var pos = rawPos > 0 ? rawPos | 0 : 0;
                return this.substring(pos, pos + search.length) === search;
            };
        }
    }

    var ConsentStore = {};
    var ConsentProviderRegistry = {};
    var ConsentGate = {};

    var CookieConsentListener = {};
    var CookieConsentRepository = {};
    var CookieConsentBanner = { closed: false };

    (function()
    {
        function CookieConsent(functional, performance, targeting)
        {
            this.functional = functional;
            this.performance = performance;
            this.targeting = targeting;
        }

        /**
         * @returns {CookieConsent}
         */
        CookieConsent.makeDefaultNoConsent = function()
        {
            var functional = false, performance = false, targeting = false;
            return new CookieConsent(functional, performance, targeting);
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.pagesWhereBannerIsHidden = [
            "/cookies-privacy-policy/",
        ];

        CookieConsentBanner.hide = function () {
            ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().hide();
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.show = function () {
            ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().show();
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.onCookiePreferencesClick = function (callback) {
            if (document.getElementById("ot-sdk-btn") !== null) {
                document.getElementById("ot-sdk-btn").addEventListener("click", callback);
            }
        }

        CookieConsentBanner.whenReady = function () {
            var waitedForMs = 0;
            var intervalDelayInMs = 10;

            function getActiveProviderSafely() {
                try {
                    return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                var interval = setInterval(function () {
                    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
                        return;
                    }
                    waitedForMs += intervalDelayInMs;

                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider || !provider.isReady()) {
                        if (waitedForMs <= 2000) {
                            return;
                        }

                        clearInterval(interval);

                        var reason = !provider
                            ? "no consent provider is registered"
                            : "consent provider is not ready";

                        reject("After " + waitedForMs + "ms, " + reason + ".");

                        return;
                    }

                    clearInterval(interval);
                    resolve();
                }, intervalDelayInMs);
            });
        };

        CookieConsentBanner.onConsentResolved = function () {
            var intervalDelayInMs = 10;
            var timeoutInMs = 2000;

            function getActiveProviderSafely() {
                try {
                    return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        
            return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                var finished = false;
                var interval;
                var timeout;
        
                function cleanup() {
                    if (finished) {
                        return;
                    }
        
                    finished = true;
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    clearTimeout(timeout);
                }
        
                interval = setInterval(function () {
                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (!provider.isDecided()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    cleanup();
                    resolve('resolved');
                }, intervalDelayInMs);
        
                timeout = setTimeout(function () {
                    var provider = getActiveProviderSafely();

                    if (!provider) {
                        cleanup();
                        resolve('timeout');
                    }
                }, timeoutInMs);
            });
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        var _state = { functional: false, performance: false, targeting: false };
        var _listeners = [];

        ConsentStore.getState = function () {
            return Object.assign({}, _state);
        };

        ConsentStore.setState = function (partial) {
            var prev = Object.assign({}, _state);
            _state = Object.assign({}, _state, partial);
            var next = Object.assign({}, _state);
            for (var i = 0; i < _listeners.length; i++) {
                _listeners[i](next, prev);
            }
        };

        ConsentStore.subscribe = function (fn) {
            _listeners.push(fn);
            return function unsubscribe() {
                var updated = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < _listeners.length; i++) {
                    if (_listeners[i] !== fn) {
                        updated.push(_listeners[i]);
                    }
                }
                _listeners = updated;
            };
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // Consent provider interface
        // =========================================================================

        var consentProviderInterface = {
            methods: ['getType', 'init', 'show', 'hide', 'isReady', 'isDecided'],
            ensureIsImplementedBy: function (object) {
                for (var i = 0; i < this.methods.length; i++) {
                    var method = this.methods[i];
                    if (!object[method] || typeof object[method] !== 'function') {
                        throw new Error(
                            "Consent provider does not implement the 'consent provider interface' correctly."
                            + " The method '" + method + "' was not found."
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        };


        // =========================================================================
        // Consent Provider Registry
        // =========================================================================

        var _consentProvider = null;

        ConsentProviderRegistry.register = function (provider) {
            consentProviderInterface.ensureIsImplementedBy(provider);
            _consentProvider = provider;
        };

        ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive = function () {
            if (!_consentProvider) {
                throw new Error('No consent provider has been registered.');
            }
            return _consentProvider;
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // CookieConsentRepository — facade over ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        CookieConsentRepository.fetch = function () {
            return ConsentStore.getState();
        };

        CookieConsentRepository.hasUserDecided = function () {
            return ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive().isDecided();
        };


        // =========================================================================
        // CookieConsentListener — facade over ConsentStore
        // =========================================================================

        CookieConsentListener.onFunctionalConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.functional !== prev.functional) {
                    callback(next.functional);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.onPerformanceConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.performance !== prev.performance) {
                    callback(next.performance);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.onTargetingConsentChange = function (callback) {
            ConsentStore.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                if (next.targeting !== prev.targeting) {
                    callback(next.targeting);
                }
            });
        };

        CookieConsentListener.triggerChange = function (partialConsent) {
            ConsentStore.setState(partialConsent || {});
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentGate
        // =========================================================================

        var consentGateInterface = {
            options: ['requires', 'selector', 'on', 'off'],
            validCategories: ['functional', 'performance', 'targeting'],
        
            ensureIsValidFor: function (options) {
                for (var i = 0; i < this.options.length; i++) {
                    var option = this.options[i];
                    if (!options[option]) {
                        throw new Error(
                            "ConsentGate registration is missing required option '" + option + "'."
                        );
                    }
                }
        
                if (typeof options.on !== 'function') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'on' must be a function.");
                }
        
                if (typeof options.off !== 'function') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'off' must be a function.");
                }
        
                if (typeof options.selector !== 'string') {
                    throw new Error("ConsentGate 'selector' must be a string.");
                }
        
                if (this.validCategories.indexOf(options.requires) === -1) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "ConsentGate 'requires' must be one of: " + this.validCategories.join(', ') + "."
                        + " Got: '" + options.requires + "'."
                    );
                }
            }
        };        

        var _gates = [];

        ConsentGate.register = function (options) {
            consentGateInterface.ensureIsValidFor(options);
            _gates.push(options);
        };

        ConsentGate.init = function (store) {
            var state = store.getState();
            for (var i = 0; i < _gates.length; i++) {
                _applyGate(_gates[i], state[_gates[i].requires]);
            }

            store.subscribe(function (next, prev) {
                for (var i = 0; i < _gates.length; i++) {
                    var category = _gates[i].requires;
                    if (next[category] !== prev[category]) {
                        _applyGate(_gates[i], next[category]);
                    }
                }
            });
        };

        function _applyGate(gate, hasConsent) {
            var elements = document.querySelectorAll(gate.selector);
            for (var i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) {
                if (hasConsent) {
                    gate.on(elements[i]);
                } else {
                    gate.off(elements[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // ConsentGate registrations
        // =========================================================================

        ConsentGate.register({
            requires: 'targeting',
            selector: '.youtube-player',
            on: function (el) {
                var src = el.getAttribute('data-src');
                if (src) {
                    el.setAttribute('src', src);
                }
            },
            off: function (el) {
                el.setAttribute('src', '');
            },
        });

        ConsentGate.register({
            requires: 'functional',
            selector: '.vimeo-player',
            on: function (el) {
                var src = el.getAttribute('data-src');
                if (src) {
                    el.setAttribute('src', src);
                }
            },
            off: function (el) {
                el.setAttribute('src', '');
            },
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Boot
        // =========================================================================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            var provider = ConsentProviderRegistry.getActive();
            provider.init(ConsentStore);
            ConsentGate.init(ConsentStore);
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Show Cookie content Banner
        // =========================================================================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            CookieConsentBanner.onCookiePreferencesClick(function () {
                try {
                    CookieConsentBanner.show();
                } catch (e) {
                    // We don't have an active provider. Ignore
                }
            });
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // Hide Cookie content Banner
        // =========================================================================
        CookieConsentBanner.whenReady()
            .then(function () {
                if (CookieConsentBanner.pagesWhereBannerIsHidden.indexOf(window.location.pathname) !== -1) {
                    try {
                        CookieConsentBanner.hide();
                    } catch (e) {
                        // We don't have an active provider. Ignore
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(function (e) {
                Bugsnag.leaveBreadcrumb("[CookieConsentBanner] Unhandled exception while executing whenReady", {
                    exception: e
                });                
            });
    }());
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">
    var GoogleTCFProvider = (function() {

        var _decided = false;

        return {
            getType: function() {
                return 'google-tcf';
            },
            init: function(store) {
                var interval = setInterval(function() {
                    if (typeof window.__tcfapi !== 'function') {
                        return;
                    }

                    clearInterval(interval);

                    window.__tcfapi('addEventListener', 2, function(tcData, success) {
                        if (!success) {
                            return;
                        }

                        if (tcData.eventStatus !== 'useractioncomplete' &&
                            tcData.eventStatus !== 'tcloaded') {
                            return;
                        }

                        _decided = true;

                        store.setState({
                            functional: tcData.purpose.consents[1] === true,
                            performance: (
                                tcData.purpose.consents[7] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[8] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[9] === true &&
                                tcData.purpose.consents[10] === true
                            ),
                            targeting: (
                                tcData.purpose.consents[3] === true ||
                                tcData.purpose.consents[4] === true
                            ),
                        });
                    });
                }, 50);
            },

            show: function() {
                if (window.googlefc) { 
                    window.googlefc.showRevocationMessage(); 
                }
            },

            hide: function() {
                // TCF does not expose a programmatic hide
            },

            isReady: function() {
                return typeof window.__tcfapi === 'function';
            },

            isDecided: function() {
                return _decided;
            },
        };

    }());

    ConsentProviderRegistry.register(GoogleTCFProvider);
</script>

    var DisplayAds = {
        display: function (identifier) {
            if (!window.location.hostname.includes("thejournal.ie")) {
                this.debugLog("Subscription check skipped, not on The Journal");
                this.deferredDisplay(false, identifier);
                return;
            }

            if (!userRepository.hasUser()) {
                this.debugLog("Subscription check skipped, user not signed in");
                this.deferredDisplay(false, identifier);
                return;
            }

            if (subscriptionCheck.isAvailable()) {
                this.debugLog("Subscription check immediately available");
                this.deferredDisplay(subscriptionCheck.isActive(), identifier);
                return;
            }

            var timeoutId = window.setTimeout(
                function () {
                    DisplayAds.debugLog("Subscription check timed out");
                    DisplayAds.deferredDisplay(false, identifier);
                },
                1000
            );

            subscriptionCheck.registerListener(function (isActive) {
                DisplayAds.debugLog("Subscription check listener executed");
                DisplayAds.deferredDisplay(isActive, identifier);
                window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            });

        deferredDisplay: function (hideAds, identifier) {
            if (hideAds === true) {
                this.debugLog("Not displaying '" + identifier + "' to The Journal subscriber");

            if (!queryParams.has("debug")) {
                return;
            }

            console.log("[DISPLAY ADS]", ...arguments);
        }
    };

<script>
    // Cache DOM elements
    const mainNavToggleHandler = document.getElementById('main-nav-toggle-handler');
    const navigationMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-categories-redesign');
    const navigationOpenButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-open');
    const navigationCloseButton = document.querySelector('.main-nav-close');
    const navigationLogo = document.querySelector('.main-navigation-logo');
    const navigationModalContainer = document.querySelector('.navigation-modal-container');
    const navigationOverlay = document.querySelector('.navigation-overlay');

    navigationOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mainNavToggleHandler.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('click'));
    });

    // Event handler for main navigation toggle
    mainNavToggleHandler.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const positionY = Math.abs(parseInt(document.body.style.top));
        const leaderBoardContainerHeight = document.getElementById('header_leaderboard_container').clientHeight;

        document.body.classList.toggle('scroll-hidden');
        navigationMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationOpenButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationCloseButton.classList.toggle('hidden');
        navigationLogo.classList.toggle('hidden');

        // Handle scroll position when navigation is open and leaderboard is visible
        if (document.body.classList.contains('scroll-hidden')) {
            document.body.style.top = `-${window.scrollY}px`;
            document.body.style.position = 'fixed';
        } else {
            document.body.style.top = '';
            document.body.style.position = '';
            window.scroll(0, positionY);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            const isNavigationOpen = navigationOpenButton.classList.contains('hidden');
            const isModalVisible = elementIsVisibleInViewport(navigationModalContainer);

            if (isNavigationOpen && !isModalVisible) {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = `calc(100vh - ${leaderBoardContainerHeight}px - 68px)`;
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'scroll';
            } else {
                navigationModalContainer.style.height = 'auto';
                navigationModalContainer.style.overflow = 'auto';
            }
        }, 1000);
    });

    // Helper function to check if an element is visible in the viewport
    const elementIsVisibleInViewport = (el, partiallyVisible = false) => {
        const { top, left, bottom, right } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const { innerHeight, innerWidth } = window;
        return partiallyVisible
            ? ((top > 0 && top < innerHeight) || (bottom > 0 && bottom < innerHeight)) &&
            ((left > 0 && left < innerWidth) || (right > 0 && right < innerWidth))
            : top >= 0 && left >= 0 && bottom <= innerHeight && right <= innerWidth;
    };
</script>
